args.sql:
SELECT 
    t1.RecordRegistry AS flow_id,
    t2.RiskAssess AS risk_score,
    t3.DataSense AS data_sensitivity
FROM 
    DataFlow AS t1
JOIN 
    RiskManagement AS t2 ON t1.RecordRegistry = t2.FlowLink
JOIN 
    DataProfile AS t3 ON t1.RecordRegistry = t3.FlowSign
ORDER BY 
    t3.DataSense DESC
LIMIT 5;
